faq.q: Does it need to be plugged in while I use it?
faq.a: No. Charge it first, then wear it cordless.

faq.q: How long does the belt stay warm?
faq.a: It gives long-lasting warmth on a single charge, enough for a workday session or a relaxing evening. Battery life depends on the heat and massage levels you use. Recharge with the included USB cable.

faq.q: Can I use heat and massage at the same time?
faq.a: Yes. Heat and vibration are set separately, so you can use either one or both together.

faq.q: Can I wear it under clothes?
faq.a: Yes. It's light and slim, and most people wear it comfortably under hoodies, jumpers or loose tops.

faq.q: Is the belt adjustable?
faq.a: Yes. The strap adjusts to fit most waists.

faq.q: Is the belt only for period cramps?
faq.a: Not at all. Many people also use it for lower back tension, tummy discomfort, muscle relaxation and cosy warmth on colder days.

faq.q: How long does delivery take?

faq.q: What if I don't love it?
faq.a: Try it risk-free with our 30-day money-back guarantee. Email orders@trendycatch.us and we'll help you with a return.

faq.q: How do I clean it?
faq.a: Switch off and unplug first. Wipe the device and strap gently with a slightly damp cloth. Don't submerge it in water or put it in the washing machine.

faq.q: Is it safe for everyone?
faq.a: Always start on the lowest heat and don't sleep while wearing it. Don't use it on broken skin. If you are pregnant, have a medical condition or reduced sensitivity to heat, check with your doctor first.
